testResults.name: risk-pipeline
testResults.result: 26 tests passed for exact allow/reduce/reject boundaries across order notional, position, gross/net exposure, size, count, daily-loss halts, strategy overrides, reduced-order rechecks, decision auditing, YAML construction, and benchmark-shaped twenty-position evaluation.

testResults.name: focused-quality
testResults.result: Focused Ruff lint, format, and ty checks passed; the synchronous risk kernel consumes only explicit immutable portfolio, price, loss, count, and strategy inputs.

decisions: A reduction restarts evaluation from the first rule so earlier constraints recheck the reduced order.
Every rule invocation, reduction, veto reason, metric, recheck pass, and halt scope is retained in an immutable audit trail.
